# ERA Modding Guide

English-only LLM reference exports: Docs, Wiki (SoD resources), ERM, native plugins, H3API and NH3API. ERM learning contains an AI-assisted introduction; Lua is deferred.

Start here: https://asmedian.github.io/modding-guide/llm/browse/index.json
- English section routing: https://asmedian.github.io/modding-guide/llm/browse/en/index.md
- Exact ERM commands/functions/events: https://asmedian.github.io/modding-guide/llm/browse/symbols/index.json
- Exact Wiki filenames and downloads: https://asmedian.github.io/modding-guide/llm/browse/wiki-resources/index.json
- Source versions and locators: https://asmedian.github.io/modding-guide/llm/browse/sources/index.json
- ERM registries: https://asmedian.github.io/modding-guide/llm/browse/reference/index.json

Choose relevant sections and topics, open a matching catalog page, then the ordered text parts. Typical files target 24 KiB; every browse file is at most 48 KiB. All exports use English; answer in the requested language without loading translated copies. Read complete command contracts, follow cross-section relations, cite canonical article URLs and anchors, distinguish evidence from assumptions and in-game testing. If browsing is unavailable, request the specific files instead of claiming to have read them.

Optional bulk/offline mirrors (large; never fetch by default):
- Manifest: https://asmedian.github.io/modding-guide/llm/manifest.json
- Full catalog: https://asmedian.github.io/modding-guide/llms-full.txt
- en/docs: https://asmedian.github.io/modding-guide/llm/en/docs.md
- en/wiki: https://asmedian.github.io/modding-guide/llm/en/wiki.md
- en/erm: https://asmedian.github.io/modding-guide/llm/en/erm.md
- en/plugins: https://asmedian.github.io/modding-guide/llm/en/plugins.md
